ports.note: Declared before the host had a tabular port. The host now provides one (table_input 0.1.0), and the implemented widget takes a table input.

ontology.note: Pack namespace only; mints no host term.

implementation.definition: implemented in the host; see supersededBy

changes.description: Imports a long-format CSV extract of published AR6 projections, keyed by site, scenario, workflow, dataset family, year and quantile. Records the dataset DOI, version, selection, extracting code and digest. Imports; does not acquire.

evidence.note: No implementation exists in this pack and none is intended. The contract is implemented in the host, whose own release carries its evidence. Blocked on a host tabular port: a projection has many rows per site, so flattening it to points would lose the key.

supersededBy.reason: A pack that ships no executable code is a specification; the host implements it. Retired here so no node type has two definitions.
supersededBy.deviation: Takes a table input rather than importing the CSV itself: the host already has a tabular importer, and a second reader of the same file would be a second place for the contract to drift.
